no: Contributed by Clark Kimberling and Peter Moses July 25, 2023.

In the plane of a triangle ABC, let P = \(p : q : r\) and U = \(u : v : w\) be distinct points. The center of the circumconic {{A,B,C,P,U}} is given by p u (r v - q w)(p v w (r - q) - q w u (p + r) + r u v (p + q )) : : See X_34585.
